violations.text: Ceiling/ceiling tiles/vents soiled with accumulated food debris, grease, dust, or mold-like substance. Ceiling tiles and HVAC vents soiled with dust.
Clean glasses, cups, bowls, plates, pots and pans not stored inverted or in a protected manner. Plates bowls top shelf not inverted on cook line.
Employee with no beard guard/restraint while engaging in food preparation. One employee preparing food no beard guard.
Employee with no hair restraint while engaging in food preparation. One employee with no hair restraints.
Establishment using sponges on cleaned and sanitized, or in-use food-contact surface. Sponge in sanitizer bucket on cook line.
In-use tongs stored on equipment door handle between uses. On oven handle.
In-use utensil not stored on a clean portion of food preparation or cooking equipment. Pizza paddles stored on top of oven with no barrier.

No conspicuously located ambient air temperature thermometer in holding unit.
Make table near hws has no ambient thermometer.
